scope: Proposed school mathematics coverage through selected introductory university topics; secondary derivatives belong in school electives in some curricula. Candidate edges are NOT mandatory learning order or KST-validated prerequisite relations. Stage labels are broad authoring contexts, not universal curriculum order. The limits-and-continuity node labels introductory intuitive treatment in this pilot, not rigorous university real analysis.

sources.label: PISA 2022 mathematics framework
sources.use: Four content-phenomenon families and distinction between content and mathematical processes.

sources.label: TIMSS 2023 mathematics framework
sources.use: Grade-relative content domains and knowing/applying/reasoning cognition; not a global difficulty scale.

sources.label: China Compulsory Education Mathematics Curriculum Standards (2022)
sources.use: Primary and lower-secondary content-strand scope only; no per-node clause or prerequisite is certified from this citation.

sources.label: China General High School Mathematics Curriculum Standards (2017, revised 2020)
sources.use: Secondary core/elective curriculum scope and grade-context review; no per-node mapping or empirical mastery claims.

sources.label: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics
sources.use: Secondary cross-curriculum comparison; conceptual categories and practices, not universal grade order.

sources.label: Knowledge Space Theory (Doignon and Falmagne)
sources.use: Research precedent for multiple possible knowledge-state and learning-path structures; current edges are author-proposed and are NOT a constructed or validated knowledge space.
